get.description: Ordered by trade_no. Empty until the backtest has succeeded.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page; omit for the first page.

From.name: from
From.description: Start of the range, inclusive (RFC 3339 UTC). Ranges are half-open [from, to).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A new ULID per logical request. The same key with the same body returns the same response for 24 hours; with a different body, 409 idempotency_key_reused.

To.name: to
To.description: End of the range, exclusive (RFC 3339 UTC).

TradeDate.name: date
TradeDate.description: The trade date; default today (IST) or the latest, as each operation says.

Conflict.description: Conflict with the current state, or an Idempotency-Key reused with a different body.

example.title: Idempotency key reused with a different request

NotReady.description: Not ready (not_ready); the body says which dependency is missing.

ValidationFailed.description: Some fields are invalid (validation_failed); errors lists each.

errors.message: must be a decimal string with at most 2 decimals

Backtest.title: Backtest
Backtest.description: A backtest run: queued by POST /v1/backtests, then running, then succeeded or failed. metrics is set once it succeeds. R is the initial risk (entry to stop) of a trade.

params_version.description: The base parameter set; overrides from the request are in params_overrides.

isins.description: Empty means each day's universe (point in time, with that day's gate).

profit_factor.description: Null when there were no losing trades.

isins.description: Empty or left out means each day's universe.

Backtesttrade.title: Backtest trade
Backtesttrade.description: One simulated trade of a backtest, in entry order.

Date.title: Date
Date.description: A calendar date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Trading dates are dates in India (IST).

Decimal.title: Decimal
Decimal.description: An exact decimal number as a string: an optional minus sign, up to 18 digits before the point and up to 8 after. Used for any fraction that is not a price or money (ratios, scores, percentages with a _pct field name). Never a JSON number.

status.description: Always ok when the answer is 200.

ISIN.title: ISIN
ISIN.description: International Securities Identification Number of an Indian security: IN, nine letters or digits, a check digit. The stock key everywhere; exchange symbols are display-only. The check digit itself is not verified by the schema.

Indicatorset.title: Indicator set
Indicatorset.description: The latest indicator values of one stock on one timeframe, at the last evaluated closed candle. values is keyed by indicator name with its parameters (ema_9, ema_21, vwap, adx_14, atr_14, supertrend_10_3, ...); null while an indicator is still warming up.

backend.description: The implementation that computed them (they must agree; see the plan's equivalence suite).

Marketcontext.title: Market context
Marketcontext.description: The market every 5 minutes, and the data of tbo.technical.market.context.v1 (subject market): index states, India VIX, breadth in the universe and the day's class from the CPR width (set at 09:15 IST, null before). While the feed is unhealthy data_quality is degraded and the decision engine issues no new calls.

change_pct.description: Change since the previous close, in percent.

cpr_class.description: narrow: a trend day is likely; wide: a range day is likely.

Money.title: Money
Money.description: An amount of money in INR (unless a currency field says otherwise) as a decimal string with up to 2 decimal places. May be negative (a loss, a debit).

Page.title: Page
Page.description: One page of a cursor-paginated list. Each list response combines this with its own item schema (allOf). next_cursor is null on the last page; pass it back as `cursor` for the next one.

items.description: At most `limit` items, in the list's documented stable order.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; null when there are no more items.

Price.title: Price
Price.description: A price per share in INR as a decimal string: not negative, up to 2 decimal places (the exchanges quote in paise). Order prices are on the tick grid; this schema does not check the tick.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem (application/problem+json), the body of every 4xx and 5xx response. `code` and `type` come from standards/error-catalogue.yaml. Never contains stack traces, SQL, internal host names or secrets.

title.description: The catalogue's title for the code; the same for every occurrence.

status.description: The HTTP status, repeated in the body.

detail.description: This occurrence, for a person to read.

instance.description: The request path this occurrence is about.

code.description: The catalogue code: what a client switches on.

Problemfielderror.title: Problem field error
Problemfielderror.description: One invalid field of a request, in a validation_failed problem.

field.description: The field, as a dotted path (`items.0.price`) or a parameter name.

message.description: What is wrong, for a person to read.

Signalcandidate.title: Signal candidate
Signalcandidate.description: A strategy fired on a closed candle, and the data of tbo.technical.signal.candidate.v1. A candidate is not a call: the decision engine scores it with the gate and the context first. side buy is a long entry, sell a short one. components are the strategy's conditions as evaluated; indicator_values the values that triggered it. params_version names the parameter set in config/strategies.yaml; a parameter change never changes this schema.

candle_start_at.description: Start of the closed candle it fired on.

strength.description: From 0 to 1, as a decimal string.

Strategy.title: Strategy
Strategy.description: An active or retired strategy and its current parameter set (config/strategies.yaml). Parameter values are strings, integers or booleans; fractions are decimal strings.

Swingsetup.title: Swing setup
Swingsetup.description: A multi-day setup found after the close, and the data of tbo.technical.swing.setup.v1. Valid until the end of valid_until_date's session.

setup_date.description: The session it was found after.

Technicalsnapshot.title: Technical snapshot
Technicalsnapshot.description: The daily multi-day view of one stock, and the data of tbo.technical.technical.snapshot.v1: built after the close (16:00 IST) and refreshed at 08:00 IST. as_of_date is the last session it uses. The liquidity fields feed the fundamental gate. Fields are only ever added.

rs_percentile.description: Relative strength (20- and 60-day return against Nifty and the sector index) ranked within the universe.

levels.description: Support and resistance zones, nearest first.

atr_pct.description: ATR(14) as a percentage of the close.

atr_pct_percentile.description: Where atr_pct sits in its own last year.

is_squeeze.description: Bollinger bandwidth is in a squeeze.

spread_est_pct.description: Estimated bid-ask spread in percent; null without enough data.

Timeframe.title: Timeframe
Timeframe.description: A candle or analysis interval: minutes (m), days (d) or weeks (w).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: An instant as RFC 3339 in UTC with a Z suffix, at most microsecond precision. Never a local time or an offset.

ULID.title: ULID
ULID.description: A 26-character ULID in Crockford base32 (upper case): the ID of every resource and event; sorts by creation time.

bearerAuth.description: A short-lived RS256 service token issued by tbo_platform, with the claims iss=tbo_platform, sub=<calling repository>, aud=<called repository> and scope (<short_name>:<read|admin|send|content|research>).
